maddeler.e:
اسبكرا (form IVq)
# اِسْبَكَرَّا (isbakarrā) /is.ba.kar.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْبَكَرَّ (isbakarra)
# اِسْبَكِرَّا (isbakirrā) /is.ba.kir.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْبَكَرَّ (isbakarra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
